Implemented the live-reload dev server. Summary:

- **`src/cli.ts`**: added `serve` command, `--port` flag (validated 1–65535), updated usage text; `build` unchanged.
- **`src/index.ts`**: exported new serve API.
- **`tests/serve.test.ts`** (new): covers CLI parsing, script injection, serving, rebuild-on-content-change, rebuild-on-template-change, 404/403 handling.
- **`tests/cli.test.ts`**: updated the two assertions that treated `serve` as invalid (now `publish`).
